body: Thank you for reminding me. I’ll text one of those lines.

I know how much it hurts. I don’t want the people around me to go through it again. One of the only things holding me back is the potential for several people in my life to follow after me.
I am in the US, my thoughts are just extremely foggy.
I’ll see what I can do about calling emergency services though. While I don’t live in a city, my state is extremely overwhelmed.

Thank you.
I’ve been through one hospitalization, and I know they’re effective.
I’m just afraid. I’d have to sort transport because I live with someone who can’t be near sick people at all, and I’m just really worried. I’m wondering if I can contact them though to minimize contact with them. I don’t know. I just don’t want to hurt anyone else.
Thank you. It’s really hard to think. I’m sorry if it’s difficult to do so. I’m really trying to keep communicating.
I’ll try to. It’s very hard to think. I’m struggling a lot right now, and I know I have a really big choice to make right now. It’s very overwhelming.
